color-fg.$description: Primary body text color. Warm near-black, paired with color-bg for AA body-text contrast.

color-bg.$description: Page background. Warm off-white that keeps the brand's yellow undertone without becoming a saturated background.

color-primary.$description: Brand yellow. Primary action color for buttons, links, and emphasis.

color-primary-hover.$description: Darker yellow used for hover/active states on primary-colored elements.

color-surface.$description: Elevated surface color for cards and inputs, distinct from the warm page background.

color-border.$description: Default border color for cards, inputs, and dividers.

color-fg-muted.$description: Secondary text color for captions, helper text, and muted labels.

space-1.$description: Smallest spacing step, used for tight internal gaps.

space-2.$description: Base spacing step, used for icon/label gaps and compact padding.

space-3.$description: Medium spacing step, used for control padding.

space-4.$description: Large spacing step, used for card padding and section gaps.

radius-sm.$description: Corner radius for small controls like chips and inputs.

radius-md.$description: Corner radius for buttons and form controls.

radius-lg.$description: Corner radius for cards and other large surfaces.

border-width-md.$description: Emphasized border width, used for focus rings and active states.

font-size-sm.$description: Small type size for captions, chips, and helper text.

font-family-base.$description: Default font stack for all text.

font-weight-bold.$description: Emphasized text weight, used for headings and button labels.

line-height-base.$description: Default unitless line-height for body text.

shadow-sm.$description: Soft elevation shadow used for cards.

button-primary-foreground.$description: Primary button text color; dark text reads clearly on the yellow fill.

button-primary-border.$description: Primary button border color, matching its fill.

button-primary-hover-background.$description: Primary button fill color on hover/active.
